input.explanation: The slow code is in this repository, in `average_spend_per_item` in src/io_shop/spend_summary.py. It is on the default path of `render_spend_summary`, used when neither rollout flag is set. The patch replaces the loop that re-summed every prefix with a single sum over the purchases. The signature, the return value and the empty-history ZeroDivisionError all stay the same, so nothing outside this repository needs to change for users to get the faster version once it is deployed.
